_doc: Which gate families hold for which ontology. A family that does not apply is NOT silently skipped: it is absent from this declaration, and the runner prints the declaration it used. Rationale per ontology is below — a gate whose expectations belong to another track (the hand-built retail story, the TPC-H benchmark) must not be the thing that turns a deploy red. `check_chapters` runs against the SERVED app (base URL), not the checkout: it reads the endpoints out of each chapter's own HTML.

retail.why: the hand-built reference: two lanes, an authored tutorial (eight chapters, now served by the app), its own metric/NL/action families

clinic.why: built by a DeepAgent from clinic_db: the generic build-track gate applies, and so do samples

tpch.why: SF0.1 benchmark: it is held to its own gate (profile switches, lane B off), not to the build track

abc.why: the cold-chain training set with declared writes and eight training pages: its own gate; its generic gate currently fails on :AtRiskDriver (see known_failures)
known_failures: check_ontology_generic: C1b/R1 — :AtRiskDriver is a definition with no :physicalTable (the ABC ontology declares a refusal concept but no table for it). Declared here rather than hidden: the generic gate is not run for abc, and this is the item that would make it pass.

logistics.why: built by a DeepAgent, with a dashboard declaration and an action fixture: the full build track 结构族自 2026-11-11 起也在声明里：此前它不在，于是 11 列未建模（各表 id + dispatch_decisions.note）与一个定义类缺 :physicalTable 一直红着而套件看不见 —— 「没声明的家族不算没通过」。

new_coldchain_v3.why: v3：由 v1 重建，数据层补齐 9 张表 + 10 个列之后，六类 Excel KPI 全部落地。91 个指标编译、0 按名拒绝；17 张面板（六类各至少一图：异常类型/责任方、按车轴荷、出勤按周、按车违章、违章类别、油耗按周、线路完成率、成本构成、实际异常、三条超载口径）+ 17 个 KPI 卡；19 条样例含 8 条 KPI 真值（手写 SQL 第二条路线）与 3 条按名拒绝。

new_coldchain_v6.why: v6：46 指标的参考版本（Trip/Stop 双粒度、并线前后对照）。结构段补齐后 structure 320 项转绿。

new_coldchain_v4.why: v4：数据层补齐 9 张表 + 10 个列之后，六类 Excel KPI 全量落地的一版（149 指标、17 面板、13 个 KPI 卡、40 条样例）。结构 330 项检查全绿：28 张业务表逐张建模（nl_events 作为平台表显式排除）、每一列都可达（含 vehicles.total_km）、9 条外键引用逐条成立。

new_coldchain_v5.why: v5：同一个库上的合并重建（汇报板物种：六家族各一张主图 + 一组 KPI 卡，首次带上 policy 阈值并标注 assumed / refused、cannot_see 5 条、定义类双路线对照）。2026-11-09 为空出重建而删掉本声明、同日重新发布回仓库，但声明没有跟着恢复 —— suite 因此判它「no gate declaration」；2026-11-11 核准后恢复，并按今天的实测更新数字：结构 329 项全绿、通用族全过、样例 1 条 UNRESOLVED（「最近 30 天」需要一个相对时间窗的声明，本库数据止于 2026-10-29）、看板 98 项 0 失败。指标数从重建时的 61 增到 84。

new_coldchain_v7.why: v7：还没建。它的建造者是 agent 355（`Ontology Builder (new_coldchain_v7)`，datasource `new_coldchain`）；本条目先声明它，是为了让 suite 把「没有 profile」说成一个具名的 NOT RUN，而不是让发布之后才发现这个 key 没有声明（v5 那条红就是这么来的）。一旦 `profiles/new_coldchain_v7/` 落地（`ontology_publish` → 人 apply），把 pending_install 改成本次的 staged id 与门禁结论。
new_coldchain_v7.pending_install: not started yet — agent 355 will build it; nothing is staged

sunhing_v1.why: sunhing_v1：新溢眼镜（新溢眼镜, HKEX:00125）的 28 个 ROE/变革 KPI 第一次以**声明**的形式落地，源库是从 SQLite 忠实迁过来的 PostgreSQL `sunhing_kpi`（23 表 / 2 361 行，迁移核对全过）。这条路线的目的就是消灭原地那套 ad hoc：原来公式与目标值同时存在于 dim_kpi、技能脚本、生成器三处，现在指标必须编译、按名拒绝，门禁替你查覆盖。
